text: The following question stood in the name of Mr Saktiandi Supaat – 43 To ask the Minister for Digital Development and Information (a) whether the Ministry is aware of any manual manipulation of delivery status codes for any parcel deliveries within Singapore; (b) what further actions, investigations or audits have the Ministry or the Info-communications Media Development Authority ordered SingPost to conduct; and (c) considering the important role that postal delivery plays for the service of legal notices and court papers, how can trust be preserved in the reliability of postal services.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
text: asked the Minister for Digital Development and Information in light of the whistle-blowing report received by Singapore Post relating to its international e-commerce logistics parcels business which was also sent to the IMDA, whether the Government will (i) conduct further comprehensive reviews of the company to identify any non-compliance matters, including with IMDA's Universal Service Obligations and Quality of Service standards for postal service and (ii) relook its fundamental review of the postal sector.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: My response today will also cover the questions filed by Dr Tan Wu Meng1, Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim2 and Mr Pritam Singh for a subsequent Sitting.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: If the Members are satisfied with the response, they may wish to withdraw the questions after this session.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: I will answer the following questions raised by Members.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: First, what is the substance of the whistle-blowing report?

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Third, does this affect the review of postal services?

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: First, what is the substance of the whistle-blowing report?

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: This is a matter of corporate governance, which the SingPost board is dealing with.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: SingPost's board has assured the Government that postal service operations are not affected.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Nonetheless, IMDA will continue to keep a close watch to uphold the public's interests.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: As the Public Postal Licensee, or PPL, we expect SingPost to meet its obligations for its regulated postal business.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: These include ensuring that domestic letter delivery meets IMDA's Quality of Service, or QoS, standards.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: SingPost's QoS performance is independently audited and the results are published on IMDA's website.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Over the last four years, SingPost has performed within the QoS standards.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: I would also assure Mr Saktiandi Supaat that postal services for legal notices and court orders are not affected.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: IMDA will continue to work closely with the CEO of SingPost's Singapore Business Unit, who remains in the role.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Our postal services have to transform to remain sustainable and accessible while safeguarding the interests of the public and postal workers.

speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
text: I recall asking the Senior Minister of State last year if SingPost, the private company, have some de facto public service role, given the role of post offices in the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority passport collections today and distribution of masks during the COVID-19 pandemic.

speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
text: I have got two related questions for the Senior Minister of State.

speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
text: And if so, is there any concern that what is happening to the unregulated international part of the business might eventually spill over to affect the regulated domestic part of the service business?

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: As I had mentioned earlier, our primary concern as a regulator is that domestic postal services to the public is not affected.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: IMDA has ascertained that this was the case.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: The whistle-blowing incident involved overseas e-commerce parcel delivery and did not affect domestic letter delivery.

That said, we are concerned with both the findings of the whistle-blowing incident and the subsequent dismissals, and are monitoring the situation closely to ensure that domestic postal services remain unaffected, especially during this period, where the new group chief executive officer (CEO) has yet to be appointed.

And as I mentioned earlier, we are working very closely with the CEO of the SingPost domestic business unit to ensure that business continuity remains, staff morale remains and that they deliver their obligations under the licensing regulations.
We are also monitoring very closely the QOS standards, and the various regulatory standards are still in place.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: As I mentioned in my reply earlier, the structural factors that the postal service sector is facing have not changed.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: There is a decline in terms of the letter postal mail.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: More of us are not sending a physical mail and more are using digital means.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: On the point about assurance that the domestic postal services remain unaffected, as I had mentioned earlier in the response to Dr Tan's question, we are closely monitoring the situation.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: And the Member mentioned about some of the exchanges made publicly between the dismissed executives and the SingPost management and board.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: I will not talk more about it because there might be litigation action between the parties.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: We are glad to note that SingPost is taking this seriously.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: For example, they have taken steps to help ensure this.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: The chairman has indicated he will step up to provide closer guidance to management.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: SingPost has also newly created a group COO role and a person has been appointed to oversee the domestic operations.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: So, these are steps that SingPost has taken and IMDA as a regulator will continue to monitor this situation closely.
